currentAllowedPairs.rationale: map-canvas-helpers.ts remains the pure parsing and combat-state seam consumed by the rendering shell in map-canvas.tsx; remove this exception when those helpers are consolidated into the canvas or move behind a differently named seam.

JoinPage and LoginPage are separate route-facing composition roots for authenticated invitation acceptance and guest credential entry; remove this exception when either flow is renamed or reorganized so the pages no longer form a heuristic pair.

The join and login route modules register distinct paths, guards, and page components for authenticated invitees and guests; remove this exception when those registrations are consolidated or renamed so they no longer form a heuristic pair.

mock-trpc.tsx assembles the React-facing mock module while mock-trpc-helpers.ts supplies the generic query and mutation factories it consumes; remove this exception when the factories are co-located with the module or move to a differently named test utility.

env-define-evaluator.ts traverses source files and delegates branch prediction to the expression semantics in env-define-evaluation.ts; remove this exception when traversal and evaluation are consolidated or the semantic engine moves behind a differently named boundary.

config-match.ts applies runtime ignore and glob predicates while config-paths.ts validates and canonicalizes authored config paths used by those predicates; remove this exception when the responsibilities are consolidated or renamed so they no longer form a heuristic pair.

character-create.ts owns validation, transaction orchestration, and persistence while importing nested proficiency, feat, and spell-slot derivation from character-create-helpers.ts; remove this exception when that derivation is folded into the service or moves behind a differently named boundary.

map-helpers.ts owns runtime map authorization, mapping, update, and bounds helpers while importing its focused row and result contracts from map-types.ts; remove this exception when those contracts are co-located or move behind a differently named boundary.

rules.hint: move the dependency down: keep utils independent of services; extract shared primitives into packages/server/src/utils, or move the caller into packages/server/src/services.
move the dependency down: services should expose operations that routers call; move router-only wiring out of the service dependency path, or extract shared types to a lower layer.
